name: @jagentchill/render-wasm
description: The JAgentChill compositor: Rust (wgpu) compiled to WebAssembly.

scripts.build: cargo build -p opencut-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/opencut_wasm.wasm --target web --out-dir pkg && node scripts/patch-glue.mjs
